template.name: Rectangle Test
template.entry_long: ema(close,{p0}) > sma(close,{p1}) and close > ema(close,{p2}) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,10)
template.notes: The 10-bar rectangle becomes a Donchian band and the fast EMA(45)/slow SMA(200) direction filter with a close above the fast EMA is used for the long breakout. The 'both averages inside the range' test, the 0.5% rectangle-height cap, the 03:00-22:50 session window, the daily losing-trade cap and the 250/750-point brackets are not expressible.
